flavor.text: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.
It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
